summary: Nomad Foods Limited filed a Form 6-K on October 30, 2026, announcing that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.17 per ordinary share. The dividend is payable November 27, 2026 to shareholders of record at the close of business on November 10, 2026. No advisor or board recommendation beyond the declaration is disclosed. The release is incorporated by reference into the company's existing Form S-8 and Form F-3 registration statements. This is a routine capital-return event rather than a special situation; watch for future dividend policy signals and payout sustainability amid frozen-food sector margin pressure.
